messages:
Srinivas: quick check — ran a speculative-coverage scan for a new quant bring-up (llama2-70b-8bit-quant). baseline greedy throughput ~120 tok/s; spec variants improve throughput but we see quality hits on short answers :thinking:

maya: can you paste the exact command and the eval set? did you include temp/top-k calibration?

Srinivas: command i used:
```
./tools/spec_scan --model llama2-70b-8bit --modes spec-2stage,hybrid-prefetch --seed=42 --batch=8 --promptset=eval/nq-1000.json --kv-warmup=auto
```
eval set = NaturalQuestions 1000 split + our sens-check (200).

ci-bot: spec_scan job 3115151515 completed: 4 variants across 8 GPUs, duration 1h12m :white_check_mark:

katie: numbers? summary pls.

Srinivas: high-level results:
- spec-2stage: +28% throughput, p95 latency -18%, NQ EM dropped 1.6% (74.2 -> 72.6) :confused:
- hybrid-prefetch: +33% throughput, p95 -22%, NQ EM dropped 2.3%
- baseline quant (no spec): matching expected quant quality; spec variants are the ones with regressions.

maya: were both runs using kv warmup? cache sizes?

Srinivas: hybrid-prefetch had kv-warmup=true and cache_size=128. spec-2stage had kv-warmup=false (by design). Also observed token-level entropy increase in first ~8 tokens under spec-2stage.

jamal: is the drop concentrated on short answers or specific question types?

Srinivas: short answers (<20 tokens) recall down ~3.5%. long answers basically flat. failures look like truncated or confidence-shifted outputs where reranker chooses shorter prefix.

katie: can we run a quick control: temp sweep 0.6/0.7/0.8 + top-k caps 40/50/100 to see if sampling calibration recovers the drop?

maya: and include float16 baseline + quant baseline so we isolate quantization vs speculative decode interactions.

Srinivas: scheduling another sweep tonight that includes: temperature=[0.6,0.7,0.8], top_k=[40,50,100], kv_cache=[64,128,256], modes=[spec-2stage,hybrid-prefetch,baseline]. will also dump per-example logits and kv-usage traces.

maya: please make sure the harness saves per-example diffs and IDs, and adds a column for token-level rank delta (baseline_rank - spec_rank) for the first 16 tokens.

Srinivas: will do. planning to run with command:
```
./tools/spec_scan --model llama2-70b-8bit --modes spec-2stage,hybrid-prefetch,baseline --temp=0.6,0.7,0.8 --topk=40,50,100 --kv-cache=64,128,256 --promptset=eval/nq-1000.json --dump-traces --outdir=artifacts/spec-3115151515
```

ops-bot: @Srinivas reserved spec-cluster-2 slots 23:00-02:00 UTC tonight.

katie: if regressions > 1% absolute on NQ EM we should gate rollout and open a quick triage.

maya: also run hallucination detector on the subset of regressed examples and capture hallucination score + any extrinsic evidence mismatches.

Srinivas: noted. plan: rerun with temp 0.6 top-k=50 first, collect traces, then run the full sweep. will attach artifacts and a short qual summary.

jamal: can you push an artifact link when the first run finishes? i'll take a look at 10 random regressions.

Srinivas: artifact index posted: https://artifacts.redwood/spec-scan/3115151515/index.html (contains diffs, per-example logs, per-token rank deltas) :eyes:

katie: nice. small ask — add a column for token re-rank distance (delta rank between baseline and spec) and one for reranker trigger flag.

Srinivas: good idea, will add. quick note: spec path interacts poorly with our beam-based reranker in the first 12 tokens; reranker often picks shorter hypothesis because logits ordering shifted.

maya: idea: dynamic policy — disable speculative decode if prefix entropy > threshold OR if reranker signals active beam scoring. fallback to baseline for first 16 tokens.

jamal: or threshold on token perplexity, cheaper to compute than reranker flags.

katie: wrap-up: run tonight, collect artifacts, then quick triage tomorrow 10:00 UTC. if NQ EM regression persists after calibration, block rollout.

ci-bot: reminder: scheduled maintenance on spec-cluster-2 at 02:30 UTC — long jobs may be preempted.
